title: EndZ Village
description:
EndZ Village is a 2D post-apocalyptic zombie survival game developed by DEVCLIED. This 2D survival game immerses you in a post-apocalyptic world infested with zombies, where humanity is fighting endlessly against the constant onslaught of infected zombie hordes.

Build a strong village to fight against the zombies. Manage your village's resources and construction. Find ways to prevent your village's destruction. Unexpected apocalyptic events may occur during gameplay.

Treacherous factions of zombies, hidden resources and untold stories are waiting to be discovered. Remember to stay vigilant for the sake of your village or risk being consumed by the untold horrors that await in EndZ Village.

-Zombie Age simulation
-Village construction
-Real-time survival engine
-Multiple types of zombies
-Variety of weapons to build and use
-Beautiful 2D graphics and animation

-Prevent attacks from zombies during village development
-Build weapons to increase attack power and defense
-Manage resources with farming
-Search for resources
-Produce meat with animal husbandry
